Kerala Corporation Councilors' Oath Sparks Political Row

A political dispute has erupted in Kerala's Kannur Corporation following councilors taking an oath invoking Allah. The BJP has declared the oath illegal and demanded its cancellation, leading to a political confrontation. The incident has caused a significant political uproar within the state.
